# telnyx_user_profile (Resource)

The profile of the user the API key belongs to: name, business details, address and notification settings (beta). There is one per user; destroy removes it from Terraform state only.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The profile of the user the API key belongs to. There is one per user.
resource "telnyx_user_profile" "this" {
  business_name = "Acme Inc."
  country       = "US"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `address_1` (String) First line of the profile address.
- `address_2` (String) Second line of the profile address.
- `business_name` (String) Business name associated with the profile.
- `city` (String) City in the profile address.
- `company_size` (String) Company size reported by the user. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `country` (String) Country code in the profile address.
- `data_locality` (String) The user's data locality: USA (United States), DEU (Germany), AUS (Australia), UAE (United Arab Emirates), or CAN (Canada). One of `AUS`, `CAN`, `DEU`, `UAE`, `USA`.
- `default_managed_account_allow_custom_pricing` (Boolean) Default custom-pricing setting for managed accounts. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `default_managed_account_inherit_emergency_terms_of_service` (Boolean) Default emergency terms-of-service inheritance setting for managed accounts, where supported. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `default_managed_account_rollup_billing` (Boolean) Default rollup-billing setting for managed accounts. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `default_notify_manager_account` (Boolean) Default setting for notifying the manager account. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `default_numbers_external_pin` (String, Sensitive) Default alphanumeric external PIN for phone numbers. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `first_name` (String) The user's first name.
- `got_free_number_at_signup` (Boolean) Whether the user received a free number at signup. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `last_name` (String) The user's last name.
- `low_balance_notification_frequency` (Number) Low-balance notification frequency. Organization sub-users cannot set a non-null frequency. The resulting profile must have both a threshold and frequency, or neither. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `low_balance_threshold_amount` (Number) Low-balance notification threshold in the billing currency. The resulting profile must have both a threshold and notification frequency, or neither. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `notify_on_invoice_available` (Boolean) Whether to notify the user when an invoice is available. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `notify_on_invoice_payment` (Boolean) Whether to notify the user when an invoice is paid. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `npac_user` (Boolean) Whether the user is an NPAC user. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `onboarding_build_method` (List of String) Build methods reported during onboarding. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `onboarding_industries` (List of String) Industries reported during onboarding. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `onboarding_monthly_budget` (List of String) Monthly budget ranges reported during onboarding. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `onboarding_product_interest` (List of String) Products of interest reported during onboarding. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `onboarding_project_types` (List of String) Onboarding project types. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `onboarding_reasons_for_consideration` (List of String) Reasons for considering Telnyx. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `onboarding_referrer` (List of String) Referral sources reported during onboarding. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `onboarding_use_cases_other` (List of String) Other onboarding use cases. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `phone_number` (String) Contact phone number associated with the profile.
- `port_out_pin_validation` (Boolean) Whether port-out PIN validation is enabled. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `primary_use_case` (String) Primary use case for the account. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `role` (String) The user's role. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `state` (String) State or region in the profile address.
- `ui_theme` (Number) User interface theme: 0 for dark or 1 for light. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `use_cases` (List of String) Use cases reported by the user. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `user_subscription_opt_in` (Boolean) Whether the user opts in to subscriptions. The API does not return this value, so changes made outside Terraform are not detected.
- `zip` (String) Postal code in the profile address.

### Read-Only

- `data_locality_migration_status` (String) Status of the user's data locality migration, or null when no migration status is recorded.
- `data_locality_updated_at` (String) Timestamp when the user's data locality was last changed, or null if it has not been changed.
- `id` (String) Always user_profile: there is one per account.
- `record_type` (String) Identifies the type of resource.
- `updated_at` (String) Timestamp of the most recent profile update.
- `user_id` (String) Identifier of the user who owns this profile.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import telnyx_user_profile.example user_profile
```
